cohort: 131,243 low-risk deliveries, including 13,242 elective inductions at term (37-41 weeks of gestation)
finding: Elective induction of labor at term is associated with decreased risks of cesarean delivery and other maternal and neonatal morbidities compared with expectant management regardless of parity or cervical status on admission.
mod_finding: Elective induction of labor at term is associated with a decreased risk of cesarean delivery compared with expectant management.
